narrative: Year-to-date comparable operating profit is €84.8M, only €0.9M behind budget — but two stories offset. Income is €12.2M short and comparable costs €4.4M over; a €15.8M credit-loss swing (a €3.5M release instead of a €12.3M charge) fills the gap. GL actuals from Oracle / Snowflake are mapped to plan accounts and decomposed into drivers, so each variance is explained, not just shown.
